bug_fix_verification.original_bug: Scanner UI controls (filters, rotation, crop, brightness/contrast) were inactive/greyed out after image capture
bug_fix_verification.root_cause: The useEffect cleanup function was terminating the Web Worker when workerReady state changed (dependency array included [workerReady, workerFailed]). When workerReady changed from false to true, React ran cleanup which terminated the worker.

changes: Lines 141-152: Init useEffect no longer has cleanup function
Lines 154-157: Separate unmount-only useEffect with empty deps [] handles worker termination
Lines 597-625: JSX disabled props use React state 'workerReady' instead of non-reactive 'isScanReady()' function

bug_fix_verification.verification_result: FIX CONFIRMED WORKING - all controls are enabled and functional after image capture
